content: Neemwe abhakuru, mubhe murabhakorera abhagya bheenyu kwe eheene na kyeego ekweenderwa. Muhiite kubha neemwe mwoosi munawe Omukuru mwiisaaro.
Obhuswaagyo na amasabhi ga Pauro
Mubhe murasabha eziisiku zyoosi, murateengeeza no okumubhuurira Taatabhugya, “Ozomirye.”

Mutusabhire na neetwe okubha Taatabhugya atwiigurire enzira yo okurwaaza engʼana yaaye iguru wa Krisito, yino ekare yaraarikiri embiso yaaye. Na neenye nibhohirwe kwiiguru yo okurwaaza amangʼana gayo.
Kweego, mubhe murasabha Taatabhugya kubha, nibhe na amanaga go okurwaaza kubhweero amangʼana gayo kyeego nikweenderwa kugaamba.
Mubhe na amangʼeeni mubhwiigwaani bhweenyu na bhano bhatakumwiikirirya Omukuru Yeesu. Mutabhurya eriibhaga.
Amangʼana geenyu gabhe mazomu na go okusakirya, okubha mumenye kyeego mukweenderwa kukyoora abhaatu bhoosi bhuzomu.
Amangʼana go okuraga
Omwiikirirya omurikyeetu omuseegwa Tikiko ni muhokya omuheene. Turakora emirimo gyo Omukuru Yeesu kwa hamwe. Ewe arabhabhuurira amangʼana gaane goosi.
Nimutumiri kweemwe okubha abhaganire amangʼana geetu no okubhatoongera eziikoro zyeenyu.
Araaza hamwe na Onesimo, omwiikirirya omurikyeetu. Ewe niwe omuutu wo oweenyu no omuseegwa omuheene. Bharabhabhuurira amangʼana goosi gano gakukorwa oweetu hano.

Aristariko, wuno abhohirwe hamwe na neenye mukibhoho hano, arabhakeerya. Mariko, wamwaabhu Barinaaba, arabhakeerya. Mumariri kusuungʼaana amaragiriryo iguru waaye. Hano araahike kweemwe, mumusuungʼaane bhuzomu.

Yeesu neewe, wuno akubhirikirwa Yusito, arabhakeerya. Gati wa Abhayahudi bhano bhiikiriirye Krisito, bhano ego nibho bhakukora emirimo kubhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya hamwe na neenye, nabho bhanitoongeeri ekoro bhukongʼu.

Epafura, omugya wa Krisito Yeesu no omuutu wo oweenyu, arabhakeerya. Eriibhaga ryoosi arakora omukya kubhasabhira emwe kubha mugumire mubhwiikirirya bhweenyu no okukongʼa, mukubha no obhukaari kugoosi gano Taatabhugya akweenda.
Ndamumenyeekererya kubha, arakora emirimo kwo omukya kwiiguru weenyu na kubhaatu bhe emigye gya Raodikia na Hierapori.
Omugabhu weetu omuseegwa Ruuka na Dema, bharabhakeerya.
Emwe, mubhakeerye abhiikirirya abharikyeetu bha Raodikia. Kweeki mumukeerye Nimufa, na abhaatu bhe ekanisa bhano bhakusikanira munyuumba yaaye.

Hano mukumara okusoma enyaarubha yino kweemwe, muyihikye kubhiikirirya bhe ekanisa ya Raodikia okubha bhayo nabho bhayisome. Neemwe mukomye enzira yo okubhona enyaarubha yino nikabhatumira ebho muyisome.
Mumubhuurire Arikipo kubha, amare bhuzomu emirimo gino Omukuru amuheeri.
Enye Pauro nirakaama obhukeerya bhuno kwo okubhoko kwaane omweene. Muhiite kubha niri mukibhoho. Orubhaango rwa Taatabhugya rubhe hamwe neemwe.
